Scotland independent; English 1560 intervention near Leith would not mean whole Scotland annexation.
Boulogne and Broughty English garrisons terminated 1550; never reappear as British colonies.
Queen's/King's County 1556 statutory law persists; legal shire naming not proof of full actual military control modern Laois/Offaly.
Jersey, Guernsey and Isle of Man retain separate political relationships.
Muscovy Russia, West Africa and Elmina are NOT England's sovereign territories.
Hammes Castle near Hames-Boucres was last English Calais Pale bastion abandoned January 1558; lost geographic site must be archived, not resurrected as English in 1560. No verified castle GPS.

Eyemouth French military work existed in independent Scotland 1557–1558; archaeology describes negotiated July 1559 exit while physical demolition could be later. Reassess 1560 actual site before marking French garrison active or English conquest.
